title: RIFT: Reward Improvement Field Transfer for Cross-Domain Offline RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.19681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning from limited target data is a central challenge in cross-domain offline reinforcement learning. Abundant source data can help, but dynamics differences can make direct transition reuse unreliable. We propose Reward Improvement Field Transfer (RIFT), which instead learns how low- and high-reward source transitions differ. RIFT encodes source and target transitions in a shared latent space, pairs low- and high-reward source transitions using optimal transport, and fits an affine field to their displacements. It applies this field to low-reward target anchors and decodes the results to augment the target dataset. The approach builds on the hypothesis that related domains can share useful low-to-high reward structure despite different dynamics. We bound synthesis error under shared class geometry, identify conditions favoring target anchoring over source-high transplant, and derive a conditional connection to downstream return. Expe

translated_title: RIFT：面向跨域离线强化学习的奖励提升场迁移
translated_abstract: 从有限的目标域数据中学习是跨域离线强化学习的核心挑战。丰富的源域数据可以提供帮助，但动力学差异会使直接复用源域转移数据变得不可靠。我们提出了奖励提升场迁移方法，它转而学习低奖励与高奖励源域转移之间的差异。RIFT 将源域和目标域转移编码到共享潜在空间中，利用最优传输将低奖励与高奖励源域转移配对，并对其位移拟合一个仿射场。随后该方法将该场应用于低奖励的目标域锚点，并对结果进行解码以增广目标域数据集。该方法建立在如下假设之上：即使动力学不同，相关域之间仍可共享有用的从低奖励到高奖励的结构。我们在共享类别几何的条件下对合成误差给出了理论上界，识别了目标域锚定优于源域高奖励移植的条件，并推导了该方法与下游回报之间的条件性联系。实验（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: RIFT通过在共享潜在空间中用最优传输配对低、高奖励源域转移并拟合仿射“奖励提升场”，再将该场应用于目标域低奖励锚点以增广数据，从而在动力学差异下实现从有限目标域数据中有效学习跨域离线强化学习策略。
en_tdlr: RIFT learns a reward-improvement field by pairing low- and high-reward source transitions via optimal transport in a shared latent space and applying this affine field to low-reward target anchors, enabling effective cross-domain offline RL from limited target data despite differing dynamics.
